summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study is testing brexucabtagene autoleucel in adults with relapsed or refractory B-cell acute lymphocytic leukemia, and in some adults with newly diagnosed high-risk B-cell acute lymphocytic leukemia. Participants first receive cytoreductive therapy with inotuzumab ozogamicin, blinatumomab, and either hyper-CVAD or mini-hyper-CVD, then lymphodepletion chemotherapy and one dose of brexucabtagene autoleucel; how long or how often is not stated. The study aims to learn about safety and whether it can help control the disease; a primary outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa brexucabtagene autoleucel en adultos con leucemia linfoblástica aguda de células B recidivante o refractaria, y en algunos adultos con leucemia linfoblástica aguda de células B de alto riesgo recién diagnosticada. Primero, los participantes reciben terapia citorreductora con inotuzumab ozogamicina, blinatumomab y hyper-CVAD o mini-hyper-CVD, luego quimioterapia de linfodepleción y una dosis de brexucabtagene autoleucel; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio busca conocer la seguridad y si puede ayudar a controlar la enfermedad; el resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Age 18 or older with relapsed or refractory B-cell ALL.
Or newly diagnosed high-risk B-cell ALL with listed genetic features.
Adequate kidney, liver and bilirubin levels, as defined in the record.
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding, or a woman who could become pregnant without a negative pregnancy test.
Prior brexu-cel or other anti-CD19 CAR T cell therapy.
Active and uncontrolled disease or infection, as judged by the treating physician.
Unable or unwilling to sign consent, or receiving other investigational therapy within 14 days.
